title: Public Release Manual Decision Input Review v0.2
objective: Review the seven recorded public release manual decisions against current local and documented evidence, confirm the unresolved branch protection or equivalent repository ruleset boundary, preserve public release no-go, and return any required maintainer choice without executing publication or changing repository state.
acceptance: Review all seven decisions recorded in docs/operations/public-release-manual-decision-intake-v0.2.md against current documented and automated evidence.
Distinguish maintainer decisions and accepted risk from professional legal or trademark clearance.
Keep public release no-go while the branch protection or equivalent repository ruleset decision remains deferred.
Determine whether the existing decisions are internally consistent and identify the exact maintainer choice still required for an equivalent release control.
Do not change repository visibility, publish npm, create a GitHub release, launch, deploy, change repository controls, contact customers, or make hosted or commercial availability claims.
Cascade the review result through canonical release, testing, acceptance, log, and Autopilot records without treating this Goal as publication authorization.
